steps.title: The Training yard
steps.body: The Training yard is a sample map made only from editor commands: training dummies, a cracked wall, a target that opens a gate, a chest, and a sparring knight who fights back. Signs on the map say what to try. One undo takes it all away again.
steps.task: Open the World menu and click “Add the Training yard”.
steps.tip: The Map list at the top of the editor switches between your maps.

steps.title: An enemy
steps.body: The sparring knight is a character with “Fights the hero” on. As a neighbour on a map it wanders until it sees the hero, walks over, raises its arm with a red “!” over its head, then swings. “Make enemy” turns any other character into one (Grunt, Brute or Swift).
steps.task: Make the sparring knight hit harder and warn you for longer.

how.text: In the list “Characters and clips” on the left, click “Sparring knight”. Its properties open on the right.

do.say: Click “Sparring knight” in the list on the left.

how.text: In the panel on the right, find the section “Fights the hero”. Click the box “Hits for”, type 2 and press Enter: each swing now takes two hearts.

do.say: Type 2 in “Hits for” under “Fights the hero” and press Enter.

how.text: In the same section, click the box “Warning before a swing”, type 0.9 and press Enter: the red “!” now shows for 0.9 seconds before each swing, time to raise your guard.

do.say: Type 0.9 in “Warning before a swing” and press Enter.

steps.title: Wire a dummy to the chest
steps.body: Wires connect objects without writing logic: when this one is used, hit, smashed, rebuilt or locked on, another one changes. The yard's target already opens the gate when you lock on to it. Now make smashing a training dummy open the treasure chest.
steps.task: Wire a training dummy: when it is smashed, the treasure chest opens.

how.text: Select a training dummy: click one of the two brown dummies on the left of the yard in the 3D view. The Inspector on the right shows it, with a section “Name, script & wires”.

do.say: Click a training dummy in the 3D view.

how.text: In the Inspector's box “New wire”, open “When this” and pick “is smashed”.
Open “Then” and pick “set another object's state”, then open “Object” and pick “Treasure chest”.
Open “State” and pick “open”, then press “+ Wire”. The wire is listed above the box (“When is smashed → Treasure chest 1: open”) and a teal line joins the dummy and the chest in the 3D view.

steps.title: Fight
steps.body: In Play: a yellow arrow shows what Z locks on to; locked on, it turns red and the hero faces it. Tap F to attack, hold F to charge, Shift+F for a heavy hit. Hold Q to guard (with a shield, a hit from the front is blocked; raise it just as the red “!” is about to strike to parry). C rolls. Lock on to the red-and-white target to open the gate; smash a dummy to open the chest.
steps.task: Open the Play menu and click “Play this map”.

steps.title: You can make fights
steps.body: Stop with F5 when you are done. Everything you used is in the editor: Make breakable and Can be locked on in the Asset studio, Fights the hero in the Character studio, Name, script & wires in the Scene, and On damaged, On defeated and On locked on in Logic. Help › Help guide › Play has every control.
